result.summary: Removes redundant assertions that verify `WALLET_FLAG_DESCRIPTORS` across descriptor-specific `CWallet` methods. It also moves the descriptor flag check out of `UpgradeDescriptorCache()` into its callers (`CWallet::Unlock` and `WalletBatch::LoadWallet`).
result.problem: Now that legacy wallets can no longer be loaded for normal operations, several assertions checking for descriptor wallets are obsolete or redundant in descriptor-only methods. Furthermore, `UpgradeDescriptorCache()` was checking the flag internally even though callers can be invoked on legacy wallets during migration, obscuring the execution flow.
evidence: Author description: 'Since the legacy wallet can't be loaded anymore, few of these assertions are outdated now.'

Commit 77778e2559: 'The `UpgradeDescriptorCache` method ends up being called via the `CWallet::Unlock` and `WalletBatch::LoadWallet` methods, both of which can be called for the legacy wallets within the context of wallet migration... This move out of the check makes it explicit for the reader that this is not the only flow for these callers.'
result.scope_notes: Small refactoring touching roughly 25 lines across 2 files without changing wallet functionality.
result.card: Removes redundant assertions verifying WALLET_FLAG_DESCRIPTORS in descriptor-specific CWallet methods and moves the descriptor check in UpgradeDescriptorCache() up to its callers. The author notes that because legacy wallets can no longer be loaded normally, internal descriptor assertions are largely obsolete and add cognitive overhead. Furthermore, moving the check to callers like CWallet::Unlock clarifies code paths that still handle legacy wallets during migration. This is an internal wallet cleanup with no user-facing behavioral changes.
